scope: Countries whose ENTSO-E coal (B02, B03, B05) arrives as per-Period source records (resolution_source=xml_period). Within these, legacy files cannot change a stored interval duration, reviewed aliases are normalized, and source names are kept literally. Add a country only together with the extractor's matching allow-list, after its strict-parser survey passes and every unit's source name either matches its stored legacy name or has a reviewed alias (see docs/ENTSOE_COAL_HOTFIX.md).
